transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... lately, I just keep catching myself thinking that it might be easier if I just didn't wake up. I mean, I haven't made any actual plans to hurt myself or anything like that. It's just that the thought keeps crossing my mind, and I figured I should probably get some help.
Did these thoughts start after something stressful happened in your life?

No, not really. I mean, nothing major stands out. It's just been the usual day-to-day stuff at work... nothing out of the ordinary. I can't really point to one specific stressful thing that set it off, to be honest. It just sort of started happening.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

Yeah, I have. It's like... well, after this big burst of energy I had a while back finally wore off, I just felt like somebody had pulled the plug on me. Most days I just sit at the kitchen table, staring at my coffee... just feeling completely empty. And ashamed, honestly. So yeah, I've definitely been feeling down.
During that burst of energy you mentioned, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually. During that time, there were quite a few nights where I'd only get maybe two or three hours of sleep. But the weird thing was, I didn't feel tired at all. I'd get up feeling like I had a full tank of gas, you know? Just completely ready to go, with no reason to slow down.
During that high-energy period, did you feel unusually important, powerful, or capable of things other people would think were unrealistic?

Yeah, I actually did. It's a bit embarrassing to look back on now, but... for a while there, I honestly believed I could just walk into any store in the district and run it better than the managers there. I don't really know why, but I felt like losing my job had somehow made me this absolute expert. I just felt completely certain that I knew how to fix everything in the business, which I guess most people would say is pretty unrealistic.
During that high-energy period, were you hospitalized because of it?
No, I wasn't. I mean, I never went to the hospital or anything like that. I just kind of... well, I just kept going until the energy finally ran out. But no, no hospitalizations.
While you've been feeling depressed, have you heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't?

No, not while I've been depressed. The only time I heard that... well, that voice telling me I was a store manager, or felt so certain I could just take over any store, was during those wired weeks right after I got fired. But once I crashed and hit this low spell, the voice completely stopped. Now I'm just left feeling pretty embarrassed about the whole thing.
